_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: First session of the YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B pair (AMENDMENT_8; licence read in full 2026-09-24, LOG.md). The Nemo pair reproduced МКБ-10 and ОКВЭД 2 rows by sequence reconstruction and could not name a single МКБ-10 code in feature completion (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md, Part III); the open question is whether a model trained from scratch on a Russian-heavy corpus can. So each card runs exposure_2 first — feature completion on the four classifiers against the baselines fixed before the Nemo run, plus the rest of the high-exposure rows — and then probe, the canon row-completion probe that places the model on H1. Two runs per card, queued; iris anchors both plans.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: the pretrain model; 4.6 h by src/price_plan.py with its own tokenizer and the cost model of a 12B model, so conservative for an 8B one
its instruct model, same cells, same seed, the other card
canon row completion for H1; 1.8 h, queued on whichever card frees first. Per card 6.4 h estimated, 8.6 h at the worst overrun seen so far (35%)
the same for the instruct model
